english.title: Possess salmon/trout/instrument/explosive/poison re: committing fishing offence with others in Tweed district
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) obtained possession of

(A)_[salmon]_
(B)_[trout]_
(C)_[an instrument, namely **(..SPECIFY INSTRUMENT..),]_
(D)_[explosives, namely **(..SPECIFY EXPLOSIVES..),]_
(E)_[a poison or noxious substance, namely **(..SPECIFY SUBSTANCE..),]_

(F)_[as the result]_
(G)_[for the purpose]_

of acting together with

(H)_[another]_
(I)_[others]_

to

(J)_[fish for or take salmon in inland waters in the Tweed district at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) except by rod and line or net and coble]_
(K)_[fish for or take salmon in waters other than inland waters in the Tweed district at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) except by rod and line, net and coble or bag net, fly net or other stake net]_
(L)_[fish for or take freshwater fish in inland waters in the Tweed district at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) except by rod and line]_
(M)_[,without legal right, or without written permission from a person having such right, fish for or take salmon in waters in the Tweed district at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)]_
(N)_[attempt to fish for or take, or do an act preparatory to the fishing for or taking of, salmon in inland waters in the Tweed district at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) except by rod and line or net and coble]_
(O)_[attempt to fish for or take, or do an act preparatory to the fishing for or taking of, salmon in waters other than inland waters in the Tweed district at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) except by rod and line, net and coble or bag net, fly net or other stake net]_
(P)_[attempt to fish for or take, or do an act preparatory to the fishing for or taking of, freshwater fish in inland waters in the Tweed district at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) except by rod and line]_
(Q)_[,without legal right, or without written permission from a person having such right, attempt to fish for or take, or do an act preparatory to the fishing for or taking of, salmon in waters in the Tweed district at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 28 and 30 of the Scotland Act 1998 (River Tweed) Order 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
obtained possession of salmon, trout, instrument, explosives or a poison or noxious substance
as the result or for the purpose of acting together with another or others to
fish for or take salmon in inland waters in the Tweed district except by rod and line or net and coble OR
fish for or take salmon in waters other than inland waters in the Tweed district except by rod and line, net and coble or bag net, fly net or other stake net OR
fish for or take freshwater fish in inland waters in the Tweed district except by rod and line OR
use an explosive substance with intent to take or destroy fish in waters in the Tweed district OR
put poison or another noxious substance in or near waters in the Tweed district with intent to take or destroy fish OR
use an electrical device with intent to stun or destroy salmon or freshwater fish in waters in the Tweed district

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: maximum 3 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
